The animations in this folder come from two packs by Quaternius (Standard versions):

- "Universal Animation Library": Jog_Fwd_Loop, Sprint_Loop
  https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library
- "Universal Animation Library 2": Zombie_Idle_Loop, Zombie_Scratch, Zombie_Walk_Fwd_Loop
  https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library-2

They were retargeted from the packs' skeleton to Epic's mannequin skeleton for this project.
